tasks.completion_summary: Implemented MCP sampling/createMessage handler — SDK client registration, CLI --sampling-stub/--sampling-stub-file flags, TUI overlay screen with manual/canned/abort options, and full SDK round-trip integration tests.
Extended sampling handler with tool-use support — ParseToolUseSpec, NewToolUseStubHandler, --sampling-tool-use CLI flag, TUI tool-picker mode.
Implemented elicitation/create handler — dynamic TUI form (text/number/bool/enum/multi-select), CLI stubs, nil-channel guard fix in tui_bridge.go.
Implemented roots/list + roots/list_changed notification — CLI --root/--roots-file, TUI roots editor (R keybinding).
Implemented OAuth — auth-code+PKCE, client credentials, FileTokenCache (XDG-aware, atomic), 8 CLI flags, TUI auth indicator + Re-authenticate keybinding.
Implemented capabilities/extensions display — CLI cmd_capabilities.go JSON output, TUI debug Capabilities tab.
Protocol version display — [MCP <version>] in TUI status bar, --debug PersistentFlag fix in main.go.
Notifications middleware — TUI Notifications tab (filter/pause/resume), CLI --watch-notifications, single AddReceivingMiddleware chokepoint.
Tool annotations — ToolAnnotations type, BadgeString(), TUI confirm overlay for destructive tools, CLI --no-confirm.
outputSchema validation — TUI warning banner, CLI --strict-output, reflect-based isNil fix for typed-nil map trap.
URI template support — internal/mcp/uritemplate, TUI template section in resource list, CLI resource/prompt complete subcommands.
isError:true distinction — TUI red error banner, CLI --strict-errors flag.
MCP-Method/MCP-Name headers (SEP-2243) — methodHeadersRoundTripper, debug pane hook, CLI --mcp-method-headers.
Custom header injection + response observer — RedactHeaders, --header KEY=VALUE, --show-headers, staticHeadersRoundTripper.
SSE edge case tolerance tests — 6 tests for empty keep-alive chunks + parameterized Content-Type.
mcp-tui verify subcommand — 6 security/behavior probes, --probe, --json flags.
mcp-tui conform subcommand — 13 protocol scenarios + 6 verify probes, JUnit XML (--report-junit), --scenario targeting.
